[P2] Preserve next() timing for PromiseLike wrapper results

Non-native wrapper results still expose the private observation and recovery reactions through this additional `.then()`. Extend the added "preserves main's native await depth in outer wrappers" test to `form="wrapper-thenable"` and `ticks=4`: the base resolves `"override"`, whereas this implementation rejects with the original callback error. The extra reactions delay the outer wrapper's `await next()` until that otherwise-later rejection has been observed, changing a successful step into a retry or failure. Preserve the original PromiseLike await depth when exposing `next()`, keep private recovery separate, and add this four-tick regression.
